method: Public sequence/equation -> learner-entered named relationships -> earlier checked learner values only.
invariants: No main-answer transfer or prefilled computed results.
Increasing and decreasing sequences use a positive gap and the appropriate addition/subtraction.
Parity keeps original source/total bounds; pure questions retained alongside addition/subtraction before pairing.
Alternating repeat patterns retain 1..9 numbers, with the blank moving among positions 3..6.
Original curriculum bounds, answers and shuffled choice labels retained.
Obsolete drafts reset; new checked partial drafts restore.
samples: 1200 generated samples per unit with at least 100 distinct public prompts in the default domain. These are not 100 distinct answers, numerical facts or stored authored questions. Tighter eight-number parity domains retain their actual finite capacity.
limits: Normal UI evidence and tests are separate.
No physical-device, learner-comprehension or release-readiness assertion.
